title: Auditor Output Frontmatter (PostToolUse Artifact Gate enforced)
description: Markdown files written to memory/audits/ or projects/{slug}/audits/ MUST have this frontmatter or PostToolUse hook will exit 2 (block edit). Borrowed from seo-geo.

class.description: Required identifier; presence triggers Artifact Gate validation

cap_applied.description: True if any Veto triggered Cap algorithm

final_overall_score.description: After Cap algorithm (1 Veto → min(raw, 60); 2+ Vetoes → BLOCKED)

ready_verdict_allowed.description: DERIVED field: verdict=SHIP AND cap_applied=false AND vetoes_triggered is empty

target_artifact.description: Path to the artifact being audited (e.g. workspace/{task}/draft.md)
